A copper-alloy Roman barbarous radiate, copying a coin of Victorinus (AD 269-271), dating to the period c.AD 275-285 (Reece period 14). INVICTVS reverse type depicting Sol advancing left raising hand and holding whip. Prototype of Mint I. cf. Normanby no. 1909. Obverse inscription: [...]TORINVS P [...] Radiate, draped, and cuirassed bust right. Reverse inscription: [...], Sol advancing left with…
